integrity: Exact all-parameter semigroup proof and finite independent consistency program; finite tests do not establish the theorem for infinitely many n.
scientific_limitations: Reduced singular locus and local analytic types; the full singular subscheme and birational resolutions are not computed. An equivalent account under other terminology may exist.
title: A single parallel pair creates disjoint singular lines and isolated Segre cones in rank-two matroid toric varieties
